# Chande Bootcamp

> Chande Bootcamp (also "Chande Bootcamp by Mingg", "Chande") is a retreat that connects Vietnamese designers — a few days to listen, share and "show the love" in the most peaceful way. It is a special event organized by Mingg Patreon - Design community. Website: https://www.chandebootcamp.com

## About the event

- What: a community-connecting retreat for Vietnamese designers (UI/UX, product, graphic, motion and other creative fields). No competitions or challenges — talks, workshops, games and time together.
- Where: Ke Retreat, Hanoi, Vietnam.
- When: the latest season took place on 2–4 October. Season 3 is being planned — interested designers can register their interest.
- Organizer: Mingg Patreon - Design community (https://www.patreon.com/cw/minggg).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.chandebootcamp.com/): the event, people, agenda, testimonials and video recap.
- [About](https://www.chandebootcamp.com/about.html): the story and spirit of the Chande design community.
- [Gallery](https://www.chandebootcamp.com/gallery.html): photos from past seasons.
- [Register](https://www.chandebootcamp.com/register.html): register interest for Chande Bootcamp Season 3.
- [Become a partner](https://www.chandebootcamp.com/partner.html): sponsorship, in-kind, media, talk/workshop and investment partnerships.
